CCLAMP: A type of clamp used to temporarily fasten two objects together in carpentry and other crafts.
CCLEF: A clef, 𝄡, indicating the position of one-lined C on a staff.
CCORPORATION: Any corporation that is taxed separately from its owners.
CCR: Initialism of Creedence Clearwater Revival (60s–70s American band).
CCTV: Initialism of closed-circuit television; video surveillance.
